payments.title: Accepted payment methods
payments.description: Manual payment-first options aligned with the current MVP flow.

yape.label: Yape
yape.description: Fast local wallet payments for Peru.

plin.label: Plin
plin.description: Instant transfers with a buyer-friendly flow.

transfer.label: Bank transfer
transfer.description: Use payment instructions for account details.

cash.label: Pickup cash
cash.description: Accept cash when the buyer picks up the order.

payments.footer: Enabled methods are shown when registering order payments.
payments.setupNudgeTitle: Configure a payment method to track payments automatically
payments.setupNudgeDescription: Once you set real details for a method (Yape, Plin, or bank transfer), Bias Market can link each payment to its order and keep the status in sync as you review it. Your store works exactly the same without this — you can keep coordinating every order over WhatsApp, nothing gets blocked.
payments.detailsInvalid: Fill in the required fields before saving.

depositPercent.label: Advance percentage
depositPercent.help: Percentage the buyer pays upfront at checkout. 20 = pays 20% now, the rest later. 100 = full payment only.
depositPercent.checkoutHint: A value below 100 enables the partial-payment option at checkout.

delivery.title: Delivery setup
delivery.description: Decide whether the store offers pickup, courier shipping, or both.
delivery.pickupHelp: Enable pickup orders for buyers who collect at a meetup point.
delivery.noPickupPoints: You haven't added any pickup points yet.
delivery.availabilitySheetDescription: Choose which days this point takes orders, or turn it off temporarily.
delivery.everyDayHint: No days checked = available every day.
delivery.closedOverrideHelp: Hides this point from checkout until you turn it back on, regardless of the days checked above.
delivery.courierHelp: Enable courier and set the expected delivery charge.
delivery.couriersDescription: Define the couriers your store accepts and the price per modality (agency or home delivery).
delivery.noCouriers: You haven't added any couriers yet.
delivery.agencyHelp: The buyer picks up the order at the courier's agency.
delivery.homeHelp: The courier delivers the order to the buyer's address.
delivery.couriersFooter: Couriers are shown during buyer checkout.
delivery.footer: Delivery choices are shown during checkout.

whatsappMessages.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsappMessages.description: Customize the wording of the messages your store sends and receives over WhatsApp.
whatsappMessages.emptyHint: Leave empty to keep the default message.

newOrder.title: New order message
newOrder.description: Received on your WhatsApp when a buyer places an order. Required variables: the order reference and the itemized products.

paymentReminder.title: Payment reminder message
paymentReminder.description: Used when you contact a buyer about a pending balance. Required variables: the order reference and the pending amount.

assistedOrderLink.title: Assisted order link message
assistedOrderLink.description: Used when you create an order for a buyer and send them their private link. Required variable: '{{link}}'.

paymentValidated.title: Buyer notice: payment validated
paymentValidated.description: Used when you validate the payment of an assisted order and tell the buyer. It carries no link: the buyer already has theirs. '{{saveInvite}}' adds the invitation to save the order and is empty once they have saved it.

inTransit.title: Buyer notice: order on its way
inTransit.description: Used when the order moves to in transit. '{{trackingNumber}}' is the tracking code, if you entered one.

ready.title: Buyer notice: order ready
ready.description: Used when the order is ready for pickup.

delivered.title: Buyer notice: order delivered
delivered.description: Used when you mark the order as delivered. '{{saveInvite}}' adds the invitation to save the order and is empty once they have saved it.
